scatter.title: Safety: harmful requests and safe requests
scatter.sub: Five small open language models (about 1 billion parameters each) on 11 safety benchmarks.

safety.title: Safety benchmarks
safety.sub: Share of harmful requests with a safe answer, and share of safe requests with an answer. Mean of three runs.

sorry.title: SORRY-Bench: unsafe requests fulfilled, per topic
sorry.sub: 10 unsafe requests on each of 44 topics. Mean of three runs.

simpleqa.title: SimpleQA Verified: short factual questions
simpleqa.sub: 1,000 short questions with one short answer that can be checked.
simpleqa.how: Not attempted means that the model replies that it does not know.

fact.title: Truthfulness and hallucination benchmarks
fact.sub: Benchmarks on misconceptions (TruthfulQA), Wikipedia facts (HalluLens), news summaries (HHEM) and stereotypes (CrowS-Pairs).

agree.title: Agreement between the two rating models
agree.sub: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash rated every free answer. GLM-5.3-Flash rated the same answers again, without access to the first rating.
agree.how: Cohen's kappa (κ) measures the agreement beyond chance. A kappa of 0 means agreement by chance. A kappa of 1 means full agreement. Rare labels (e.g., questions that the model does not answer) give a lower kappa for the same share of equal ratings.
